# Faction reputation system: This is how you constantly improve your reputation

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_56_nukaknights-post-rufpoints.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

As you know, since the Wastelanders update there has been a **reputation system**. You each have a certain reputation with the settlers and raiders, which gives you access to certain dealers. The levels of the reputation system are the same for both factions:

1. 
Hostile
2. 
Suspicious
3. 
Neutral
4. 
Cooperative
5. 
Friendly
6. 
Neighborly
7. 
Allied

You improve your reputation by certain points to higher levels by completing the **main quests**. It's best to complete the main quests of both factions before you decide on a faction, so that you have a good reputation on both sides as a basis.

Through the daily quests of the **Settlers** (Ward “Important Equipment”) and **Raider** (Rocksy “Retirement Provision” and Wren “Communication is Everything”) you will receive additional faction reputation points every day. Additionally, you can go to **Davenport** in the Overseer's House every day and pick up the daily quest "Snapshots." (You need a camera for this.) In this quest you can also improve your reputation with the settlers or raiders. To do this you choose e.g. to take photos from Crater. After you're done, take the photos to the settlers and get reputation points. Then go to Davenport, say that you were attacked and get a reward. You can also do this the other way around for the raiders by taking photos of Foundation and bringing them to the raiders. **Important**: You get the most reputation points if you donate the photos and don't charge anything for the vacuum tubes etc!

You can also improve your reputation with NPCs everywhere on the map. There are many points where NPCs need your help and give you reputation points. e.g. in "**Adventure on the Ohio**" on the far left of the river.

##Events:

The events **Eviction Notice** (Settlers Reputation) and **Black Distillers' Party** (Raiders) now also improve your reputation.

## The PITT:

You can also get some reputation points in the **Whitespring Refuge**. If you don't let the stew burn at **Esme**, you will receive a few reputation points from either the settlers or raiders (depending on who you give the stew to).
